newsitem.title: UK: Copper edges up during late LME trade.
newsitem.headline: Copper edges up during late LME trade.

text.p: Copper prices edged up towards the higher end of the day's range during Wednesday evening LME trading, and were challenging resistance once more.
Traders said the market had become oversold this week during a fund inspired sell-off, although prices need to surmount $2,320 resistance to offset some bearish chart signals.
At 1801 gmt three months prices were indicated at $2,310/13 a tonne, up slightly from kerb levels. Aluminium also inched higher and was indicated at $1,597/99 a tonne.
